components.name: Dialslide
components.description:
One horizontal slider for everything that scrolls sideways.

- Default: any row of children, with scroll buttons (click steps, hold
  glides, double-click jumps), drag, arrow/Home/End keys and edge fades.
- `variant="calendar"`: square day cubes over a date range, centered on
  the selected day, with the month in view and arrows that hop between
  days that have events. `layout="grid"` slides between whole-month pages.

props.name: viewportClassName
props.description: Classes for the scrolling row (gap, padding, snap).

props.name: viewportRef
props.description: Ref to the scrolling row, for callers that scroll it themselves.

props.name: stepPx
props.description: Pixels per arrow click and per arrow key.

props.name: momentum
props.description: Keep gliding after a quick drag is released, easing to a stop.

props.name: detents
props.description: Settle on whole items after a drag, ticking item to item like a spun dial.

props.name: centerFocus
props.description: Keep the middle day full size and shrink and fade the rest by distance.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the edges that have more content past them.

props.name: snap
props.description: Snap items to the start edge (give items `snap-start`).

props.name: overlay
props.description: Centered layer above the row, e.g. the month label on a calendar.

props.name: onJumpToNearest
props.description: Single click on an arrow jumps to the nearest landmark instead of stepping.

props.name: onJumpToFirstLast
props.description: Double click on an arrow jumps to the first or last landmark instead of the edge.

props.name: from
props.description: First day, `yyyy-MM-dd`. Defaults to two weeks before today.

examples.title: calendar · strong center focus
examples.setup:
const CALENDAR_EVENT_OFFSETS: [number, DialslideEvent][] = [
  [-9, { count: 2, note: "Two jobs closed out" }],
  [-6, { count: 1, note: "Site walk" }],
  [-2, { count: 3, note: "Crew on site", tone: "accent" }],
  [0, { count: 4, note: "Crew on site", tone: "accent" }],
  [1, { count: 1, note: "One hold", tone: "warning" }],
  [3, { count: 6, note: "Full day", tone: "accent" }],
  [8, { count: 2, note: "Inspections" }],
  [12, { count: 1, note: "Permit renewal", tone: "warning" }],
  [19, { count: 5, note: "Pour day", tone: "accent" }],
  [27, { count: 2, note: "Walkthrough" }],
]

const CALENDAR_EVENTS: Record<string, DialslideEvent> = Object.fromEntries(
  CALENDAR_EVENT_OFFSETS.map(([offset, event]) => [
    format(addDays(new Date(), offset), "yyyy-MM-dd"),
    event,
  ])
)
